News global nation business lifestyle entertainment technology sports opinion LATEST NEWS STORIES HEADLINES METRO REGIONS NATION WORLD CDN NEWSLETTER Key Moments Related Stories Key moments Related stories Special Coverage LIVE UPDATES: Asean Summit 2026 and related meetings | Nov. 16 09:36 AM November 16, 2026"> INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 09:36 AM November 16, 2026 Latest updates Latest Oldest MANILA, Philippines — With geopolitical tensions, regional security concerns and economic uncertainties looming over Southeast Asia, Manila becomes the center of high-level diplomacy as the Philippines hosts the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits from Nov. 15 to 18.
President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. leads the gathering, which brings together Southeast Asian leaders and dialogue partners, including the United States, China and Japan, for discussions on issues shaping the region’s future.
Among the key concerns are the crisis in Myanmar, tensions in the South China Sea, the economic fallout from the Middle East conflict and regional cooperation.
Follow our live updates for the latest developments, key statements, agreements and other developments from Manila./dp
